name: Amla Shot
subtitle: the sourest thing in the Indian kitchen, drunk before breakfast

ingredients.note: frozen amla works; bottled juice is a different drink
leave it out and it is vegan, and considerably harder work

steps.text: Deseed the amla and chop it roughly. The flesh browns within minutes, so work quickly.
Blend with 60ml water until no lumps remain.
Strain through a fine sieve, pressing the pulp against it. Stir in the lemon juice, honey and black salt.
Drink at once. Amla oxidises fast and turns dull and flat within the hour.

storage: Made to order. It will hold four hours refrigerated, losing sharpness and colour as it goes.

provenance.note: Amla has been in Ayurvedic use for centuries, and in Indian kitchens as murabba and pickle far longer than as a shot. Weight for weight it carries around twenty times the vitamin C of an orange.
